STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: origen_140747.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: origen_140747.v · Open raw
module origen_140747 (
    input wire clk50mhz,
    input wire reset,
    inout wire [15:0] DRAM_DQ,
    output reg [11:0] DRAM_ADDR,
    output reg DRAM_LDQM,
    output reg DRAM_UDQM,
    output reg DRAM_WE_N,
    output reg DRAM_CAS_N,
    output reg DRAM_RAS_N,
    output reg DRAM_CS_N,
    output reg DRAM_BA_0,
    output reg DRAM_BA_1,
    input wire [21:0] iaddr,
    input wire [15:0] idata,
    input wire rd,
    input wire we_n,
    output reg [15:0] odata
);

    localparam [3:0] 
        INIT = 4'd0,
        IDLE = 4'd1,
        ACTIVATE = 4'd2,
        READ = 4'd3,
        WRITE = 4'd4,
        PRECHARGE = 4'd5,
        REFRESH = 4'd6;

    reg [3:0] state, next_state;
    reg [9:0] refresh_counter;
    reg [3:0] init_counter;
    reg [15:0] data_out_reg;
    reg data_out_en;

    wire [1:0] bank;
    wire [11:0] row;
    wire [7:0] col;

    assign bank = iaddr[21:20];
    assign row = iaddr[19:8];
    assign col = iaddr[7:0];

    always @(posedge clk50mhz or posedge reset) begin
        if (reset) begin
            state <= INIT;
            refresh_counter <= 10'd0;
            init_counter <= 4'd0;
        end else begin
            state <= next_state;
            refresh_counter <= refresh_counter + 1'b1;
            if (state == INIT) init_counter <= init_counter + 1'b1;
        end
    end

    always @(*) begin
        next_state = state;
        DRAM_ADDR = 12'd0;
        DRAM_BA_0 = 1'b0;
        DRAM_BA_1 = 1'b0;
        DRAM_CS_N = 1'b0;
        DRAM_RAS_N = 1'b1;
        DRAM_CAS_N = 1'b1;
        DRAM_WE_N = 1'b1;
        DRAM_LDQM = 1'b0;
        DRAM_UDQM = 1'b0;
        data_out_en = 1'b0;

        case (state)
            INIT: begin
                if (init_counter == 4'd15) next_state = IDLE;
                DRAM_ADDR = 12'b0010_0000_0000; // Mode register set
                DRAM_RAS_N = 1'b0;
                DRAM_CAS_N = 1'b0;
                DRAM_WE_N = 1'b0;
            end
            IDLE: begin
                if (refresh_counter >= 10'd750) next_state = REFRESH;
                else if (rd || !we_n) next_state = ACTIVATE;
            end
            ACTIVATE: begin
                DRAM_ADDR = row;
                DRAM_BA_0 = bank[0];
                DRAM_BA_1 = bank[1];
                DRAM_RAS_N = 1'b0;
                next_state = rd ? READ : WRITE;
            end
            READ: begin
                DRAM_ADDR = {4'b0000, col};
                DRAM_BA_0 = bank[0];
                DRAM_BA_1 = bank[1];
                DRAM_CAS_N = 1'b0;
                next_state = PRECHARGE;
            end
            WRITE: begin
                DRAM_ADDR = {4'b0000, col};
                DRAM_BA_0 = bank[0];
                DRAM_BA_1 = bank[1];
                DRAM_CAS_N = 1'b0;
                DRAM_WE_N = 1'b0;
                data_out_en = 1'b1;
                next_state = PRECHARGE;
            end
            PRECHARGE: begin
                DRAM_ADDR = 12'b0100_0000_0000; // All banks
                DRAM_RAS_N = 1'b0;
                DRAM_WE_N = 1'b0;
                next_state = IDLE;
            end
            REFRESH: begin
                DRAM_RAS_N = 1'b0;
                DRAM_CAS_N = 1'b0;
                next_state = IDLE;
            end
        endcase
    end

    always @(posedge clk50mhz) begin
        if (state == READ) odata <= DRAM_DQ;
        if (state == WRITE) data_out_reg <= idata;
    end

    assign DRAM_DQ = data_out_en ? data_out_reg : 16'hzzzz;

endmodule
